goal: Remove the active NoteGen remote configuration dependency from zeroxB Windows startup and make the product boundary deterministic.
non_goals: Do not redesign model configuration UI.
Do not add a zeroxB cloud endpoint.
Do not change user-configured model providers or API access.
acceptance_criteria: Windows startup no longer invokes NoteGen remote default configuration
download.notegen.top is absent from zeroxB runtime source and Tauri config
foundation contract detects any reintroduction of the upstream endpoint
foundation contract and frontend build pass
notes: Use the fixed UTF-8 I/O baseline.
Prefer the smallest change that preserves built-in defaults and user-configured providers while eliminating automatic upstream network access.
